name: A Lost Master

meta.next: Escape Through Stealth or Escape Through Force

summary: Having gathered pelts and fine thread, you carry the completed Enchanted Moonstalker Cloak into the wilds of Darkshore to find the missing night elf, Volcor. Guided by his loyal white bear Grimclaw, you must track down the wounded scout before hostile furbolgs finish him off.

sections.title: A Beacon in the Woods
sections.body: After Terenthis in Auberdine weaves the Enchanted Moonstalker Cloak, the search for the missing scout Volcor begins in earnest. His bear companion, Grimclaw, has returned to the road south of the settlement, standing watch for any ally sent by Terenthis. By offering a familiar greeting to the loyal beast, travelers are led directly off the beaten track toward the cave where Volcor lies in hiding.

sections.title: Hiding in the Dark
sections.body: Volcor sought refuge within a cavern after suffering severe injuries at the hands of the local corrupted furbolgs. Trapped and bleeding, he has had to rely entirely on stealth and Grimclaw's wits to avoid being overrun. The enchanted cloak provides him with the concealment and hope necessary to plan his extraction, though his wounds leave him in precarious condition for the return trek to Auberdine.

faq.answer: Volcor is a night elf scout based out of Darkshore who went missing while venturing near hostile furbolg encampments. He was badly wounded during a confrontation and managed to crawl into a nearby cave, while his companion bear Grimclaw sought aid.

faq.q: How do you find Volcor's hiding spot?
faq.answer: Grimclaw waits alongside the road south of Auberdine. Waving to the beast lets him know you are the helper sent by Terenthis, prompting Grimclaw to run directly toward the secluded cave where Volcor is nursing his injuries.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Enchanted Moonstalker Cloak?
faq.answer: Terenthis enchanted the cloak crafted from fine thread and moonstalker pelts to grant brief, potent magical stealth. Its magic lets you walk unhindered by Darkshore's creatures while you search for Volcor, and the cloak is then given to him.

Volcor was ambushed and wounded by the corrupted furbolg tribes roaming Darkshore. Though he managed to evade immediate slaughter, his injuries prevented him from making the journey back to Auberdine unassisted.

Once Volcor receives the enchanted cloak, he catches his breath and asks for your assistance in escaping the wilderness, offering you a choice between guiding him out through careful stealth or cutting a path through the furbolgs by raw force.

angles.text: The bond between night elf scouts and their animal companions is demonstrated here by Grimclaw's steadfast loyalty in seeking aid for his master Volcor.
Seeing Grimclaw navigate the road to locate help for Volcor highlights the remarkable intelligence and devotion of well-trained Kalimdor beasts.
Auberdine depends on scouts like Volcor to monitor the rising corruption of Darkshore's furbolg tribes, making his rescue a vital priority for the outpost.
